fusions.name: Unhurried Lob
fusions.desc: Lobs a slow crescent of water that deals 5 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Wake
fusions.desc: After a 1.5 second cast, rolls a wave 5 tiles ahead that deals 30 damage to everything in it and leaves it [Slowed] for 6 seconds. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Calm Shallows
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Buoyant Reserves
fusions.desc: When you are healed, a shield worth 8% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
